2609.18516.title: Align, Integrate, and Fire: Efficient Token-Level Alignment for Zero-Shot SpeechLLMs
2609.18516.paper_summary: While Large Language Models excel in natural language processing, efficiently extending their capabilities to spoken input remains a significant challenge. Existing methods for building SpeechLLMs often rely on computationally expensive full-model fine-tuning, or employ parameter-efficient projectors that suffer from inefficient token sequence lengths and costly full-model supervision. In this paper, we introduce Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire, a highly efficient framework for zero-shot speech processing. Our method dynamically compresses continuous acoustic frames into the exact discrete token length of the target text utilizing explicit Dynamic Time Warping alignments. This allows our initial training stage to establish a robust acoustic-to-semantic bridge using lightweight distance metrics, entirely bypassing the computationally expensive LLM forward pass. For subsequent fine-tuning, we propose a memory-efficient knowledge distillation objective that targets a single LLM layer, performing competitively with full-model cross-entropy training at a fraction of the computational cost. Through extensive evaluations on Automatic Speech Recognition and Speech Translation, we demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance compared to prior parameter-efficient baselines.
2609.18516.paper_summary_zh: 雖然大型語言模型在自然語言處理方面表現優異，但有效地將其能力擴展到語音輸入仍然是一個重大挑戰。現有的構建SpeechLLMs的方法通常依賴於計算成本高昂的全模型微調，或使用參數高效的投影器，但這些方法在令牌序列長度上效率低下，並且需要昂貴的全模型監督。在本文中，我們介紹了對齊的連續整合與發火（Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire），這是一個高效的零樣本語音處理框架。我們的方法動態地將連續的聲學幀壓縮為目標文本的確切離散令牌長度，利用明確的動態時間扭曲對齊。這使我們的初始訓練階段能夠使用輕量級距離度量建立穩健的聲學到語義橋樑，完全繞過計算成本高昂的LLM前向傳遞。對於後續的微調，我們提出了一個記憶高效的知識蒸餾目標，針對單個LLM層，並在計算成本的極小部分下與全模型交叉熵訓練競爭表現。通過對自動語音識別和語音翻譯的廣泛評估，我們證明我們的方法在性能上超越了先前的參數高效基準。
